summary: This tutorial covers how to use LibreOffice Writer on GNU/Linux for viewing and printing documents. It explains two primary view options: Print Layout and Web Layout. Print Layout shows how a document will look when printed, while Web Layout displays it as it would appear in a web browser, useful for creating HTML documents. Full Screen mode can be accessed via the View menu or by pressing Escape to exit. To add a new page, select Insert > Manual Break > Page Break. Zoom options allow adjusting the display size of the document, with Fit Width and Height showing the entire page, Fit to Width displaying the page at its actual size, and Variable allowing custom percentages. The View Layout option changes how text documents are displayed, with settings like Auto and Single Page. Status bar icons control these settings, offering quick adjustments between different view modes.
